title.narrative: DRC Transport and Connectivity Support Project

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to provide resilient, safe, and sustainable connectivity in and between selected provinces in Kasai region and Eastern part of DRC, and to increase the transparency of FONER, RVA, and the Regulatory Authority of Post, Telecommunications, and ICT.

The aim is to carry out this operation in order to reallocate the budget with a view to extending the Mbuji-Mayi-Kabinda-Mbanga section to a 2x2 lane design and redistributing the available funds to fill the various gaps in the works contracts related to this modification.
